title: Namuna: ovoz ustiga jonli illyustratsiya (A usul)
style: Painterly digital illustration, semi-realistic with soft brushwork. Deep teal and dark blue shadows dominate the frame; a single warm golden light source glows and casts volumetric rays with floating dust. Figures are faceless silhouettes or seen from behind, in modest traditional Central Asian clothing. Uzbek interior details: carved wooden doors, suzani textiles, ceramic teapots. Cinematic, quiet mood. The lower third of the frame fades into deep empty shadow.

shots.line: Ayol kishi go'zalligini eridan yashirmasligi kerak
shots.image_prompt: Close-up: a woman's hand lifts a glowing golden patterned silk shawl out of an old carved wooden chest. A small oil lantern stands beside the chest.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow push-in. The shawl rises and ripples gently as if weightless, the lantern flame flickers, dust floats in the light. Everything else stays still.

shots.line: aks holda erkakning ko'zi boshqalarida bo'ladi
shots.image_prompt: Wide shot from behind: the silhouette of a man in a long coat walks away down a foggy village street at night. One street lamp glows above him, a few lit windows far ahead.
shots.motion_prompt: Static camera. The man walks slowly away, fog drifts across the street, the lamp flickers faintly. Calm, slow motion.

shots.line: shu tariqa er-xotin o'rtasida sovuqchilik boshlanadi
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot: two figures sit apart at opposite ends of a low table, not facing each other, two untouched tea bowls between them. A frost-covered window above them lets in cold blue light; no warm light in this frame.
shots.motion_prompt: Very slow push-in. Faint steam rises from one tea bowl, snow falls outside the window. The figures stay completely still.
